steps.message:
Execute: adb shell "content query --uri content://org.tasks/tasks --projection title:importance:dueDate:deleted 2>/dev/null | python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,re,datetime
rows=sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
for line in rows:
    m1=re.search(r'title=([^,]+)',line)
    m2=re.search(r'importance=(\d+)',line)
    m3=re.search(r'dueDate=(\d+)',line)
    m4=re.search(r'deleted=(\d+)',line)
    if not (m1 and m2 and m3 and m4):
        continue
    title=m1.group(1)
    imp=int(m2.group(1))
    due_ms=int(m3.group(1))
    deleted=int(m4.group(1))
    if deleted!=0:
        continue
    wd=datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(due_ms/1000).strftime('%A')
    if imp==3 and wd=='Friday':
        print(title)
PY"
